title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms a categorical variable into a binary matrix. Each category becomes a column, and a row has a $$1$$ in the column corresponding to its category and 0s elsewhere. How might changing the values in these columns affect the model's predictions?

title: Effect of Scaling on Linear Models
text: Consider how scaling the input features (like changing 1s to 3s or 2s) affects the coefficients of a linear model. Does it change the relationship between the features and the target variable?

title: Comparing Models m1 and m2
text: If the model's predictions are based on the relative differences between feature values, how would changing the scale of one feature affect the average squared loss?
